"""Real DDS receipt and absent-stream rejection; no robot/simulator episode."""
import sys,subprocess,time,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/"scripts"))
from ros_smoke_test import require_message
source = '''import os,signal,rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node
from std_msgs.msg import String
rclpy.init()
n=Node("p3b5_native_probe_fixture")
p=n.create_publisher(String,"/p3b5/native_probe_check",10)
t=n.create_timer(.1,lambda:p.publish(String(data="actual DDS receipt")))
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,lambda *a:os._exit(0))
rclpy.spin(n)
'''
producer = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-c",source])
result = {"scope":"Real DDS component checks only; no Gazebo or mission",
          "source":Path(__file__).read_text(),"producer_source":source}
try:
    start=time.monotonic()
    require_message("/p3b5/native_probe_check",15.,("--qos-reliability","reliable"))
    result["real_receipt_wall_sec"] = time.monotonic()-start
    start=time.monotonic()
    try:
        require_message("/p3b5/deterministically_absent",.75,("--qos-reliability","reliable"))
    except (TimeoutError,RuntimeError) as error:
        result["absent_rejected"] = repr(error)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("missing stream falsely accepted")
    result["absent_wall_sec"] = time.monotonic()-start
    assert result["absent_wall_sec"] < 2.
    result["status"] = "PASS"
finally:
    producer.terminate()
    producer.wait(timeout=5.)
    Path("/tmp/p3b5_native_probe_real_checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if "source" not in k}))
